region: US (China-based historically; reincorporated as Florida investment vehicle in 2025)

10k.note: Latest available 10-K is from 2013 covering FY2012. Company was a Chinese animal nutrition / feed additive manufacturer (Guangzhou Tanke). No drug development pipeline disclosed; revenue derived from organic trace mineral additives, functional regulation additives, and herbal medicinal additives sold to Chinese livestock and poultry feed producers. R&D spend FY2012 was ~$291k (process technology, not pharmaceuticals).

website.note: https://tnbi.com/pipeline returns 404. No corporate biopharma pipeline page exists.

secondary_research.note: Per public 2025 disclosures (GlobeNewswire, OTC Markets), Tanke Biosciences was repurposed in Q1 2025 as a diversified investment vehicle (previously briefly an energy monitoring shell). New CEO Vincent Renz (Feb 2025) and Executive Chairman John P. Hopkins (Mar 2025). No therapeutic or device development program announced.

commercial_product.legacy_business: Animal feed additives sold in China (Organic Trace Mineral Additives ~86%, Functional Regulation Additives ~11%, Herbal Medicinal Additives ~1%). Operations were discontinued / divested as part of the 2024-2025 corporate restructuring.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Mis-bucketed via wide keyword match. Tanke Biosciences is not a biopharmaceutical company. Historically a Chinese animal feed additive manufacturer (per 2013 10-K, the most recent available SEC filing). Repurposed in 2025 as a diversified holding/investment vehicle. No proprietary drug, biologic, or device development program disclosed. No clinical trials on ClinicalTrials.gov.
